spec_evidence.checked: Cached stripe OAS snapshots (openapi/spec3.json): payments_primitives_payment_records_resource_payment_method_card_details lists description, iin, issuer and stored_credential_usage in v2323 and drops all four in v2324 (stored_credential_usage spec-wide token 1 -> 0; issuer property-bearing schemas 13 -> 12; the only remaining iin property lives on the unrelated legacy "card" source schema). The terminal surfaces payment_method_card_present and payment_method_details_card_present keep description/issuer in both versions, and the charge-surface payment_method_details_card has none of these fields in either version, so the removal is scoped to payment_records / payment_attempt_records read and report responses. The 40 records are 10 operations x 4 fields, projections of this single schema change.
